title: Palette Parade
style: Instrumental showcase, hybrid cinematic pop with crisp midtempo pulse and a playful groove; verse sections rotate through piano, acoustic guitar, synth plucks, strings, brass hits, and hand percussion; pre-drop strips to marimba, bass, and ticking percussion, then chorus opens wide with layered ensemble chords and rhythmic stabs; bridge spotlights solo color changes and short fills before a final lift. Featured ear candy includes reversed swells, bell runs, tom rolls, and sparkling chimes. Bright, polished, and spacious mix with punchy transients and glossy stereo width.
